okf_agent.description: Answers questions about the OKF bundle (GPT-4 technical report and related papers) from retrieved passages, with [concept id] citations. Replies 'The bundle does not contain this.' when the answer isn't in the bundle.

paper_scout.description: Finds research papers on arXiv for a topic, including recent ones that are not in the OKF bundle. Returns up to 5 papers with [arXiv:id] citations, a one-line reason each, and links. Understands 'recent/latest' and 'since <year>'.
